name: Jabugo (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a central band of green, black and red stripes, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Jabugo (scales and a tree on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Jabugo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: three narrow stripes across the centre
